m6.text:
Motion
On load, once: the falling Tunde tag drops into the hat, 600ms on cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), starting at translateY(-24px) and opacity 0. Everything else is still. Reduced motion: fade only.

m7.text:
Behaviour
The preview tag is the same card invitees see on Join, and it updates as you type with no animation. Signed-in organisers skip the email field. The magic link creates the group on arrival.

m1.text:
Motion
Invite tag drops in once on load: 400ms ease-out, rotate -8deg to -3deg, opacity 0 to 1. Buttons press to scale 0.97 in 160ms. Nothing animates while typing.

m2.text:
Motion
Members arrive over Supabase Realtime. A new tag enters with opacity + translateY(8px), 250ms ease-out, 40ms stagger. The counter swaps digits with a short blur crossfade. Sonner toast: "Leo unwrapped theirs".

m3.text:
Play this one
Hold fills through clip-path (1.1s linear). Letting go snaps back in 200ms ease-out, so it is always interruptible. Lid leaves in 500ms on cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), tag springs out with a little overshoot. Only transform, opacity and clip-path move.

m4.text:
Motion
People open this screen often, so it stays almost still. The name tag carries over from the draw as a shared element (Motion layoutId). The tick draws in 150ms.

m5.text:
Motion
Vaul drawer: follows the finger, dismisses on velocity, settles in 500ms on cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). The page behind scales to 0.96. A saved wish grows into the list by height.
